title: Hanasato Minori — My First Vocal Range Check!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough practice for today...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Good work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: G-Good work...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You did really well today, Minori♪
Your energy during the chorus was great!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... The lyrics feel really “cheerful and energetic”, so I did my best to make that as obvious as possible.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
That explains why I liked your happy footwork so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay...
B-But I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, no sitting before getting in a proper cooldown. Just hang in there a little bit longer...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Once that's done, you'll be rewarded with drinks. We've prepared some cool lemonade for you today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Reward drinks...!
I'm ready for our cooldown!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez, you're so easy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Since practice is going so well right now, you should be able to smoothly transition into your new song after you master this dance routine.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, you're getting the demo for that pretty soon, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I can't wait to hear what it's like!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me neither. Based on the melody we heard before, I have a feeling it's going to be a wonderful song.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The way she worded the lyrics was nice too. In that sense, it really felt like it was written just for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah. That was just part of it too.
Imagine what the complete package is gonna be like!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I'm so glad we asked her to do this for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She probably had to work up a lot of courage to contact us, so I'm super grateful that she sent us that email!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's really nice. I'm looking forward to hearing it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, this is so amazing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's amazing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How our thoughts and feelings have become a part of our outfits and songs!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We have all these feelings, but you can't really see them or easily describe them to others, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But our outfits and songs send everyone a clear message because they've been inspired by our feelings! Isn't that incredible?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You have a point. Seeing the outfits Shizuku designed for the first time was pretty amazing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, she's right! Having a design on paper was great, but seeing our outfits in real life was something else!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It really felt like they could cast this wonderful spell on us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Shizuku, it's your feelings and the feelings of those who made them in physical form!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The song and dance routine we were just practicing feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The song's lyrics are meant to cheer people up, so it's just as important to make sure it's choreographed in a way that encourages everyone too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Especially since you've been putting so much effort into improving your footwork, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm still not there yet, but I'm doing my best to exaggerate each step and make myself visible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's no different from the idols you're all trying to be, right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? No different?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Aren't you all striving to be idols who “give them hope for a better tomorrow”?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The thought that your outfits and songs have been imbued with your feelings is indeed beautiful, but you're just as incredible as individuals.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You really think so...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm with him!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, your fans had smiles on their faces after seeing all of you perform in person, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means we were able to cast a spell on them too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A spell that gives them hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
A spell of hope...
That does sound wonderful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That means you girls, as spellcasters of hope, are going to be singing a song written by someone who feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-You're right!
Doesn't that make us super strong?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! Now I really can't wait to hear that demo!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'm gonna keep practicing my singing and dancing to make sure I get my feelings across!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's the spirit, Minori! You can do it♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you... Even though practice left you totally exhausted a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.
